tvShow.name: Never-Ending Summer
tvShow.overview: To save her gravely ill grandmother, top student Zhou Wan approaches her mother's stepson, Lu Xixiao, for funds. They fall for each other over the summer after graduation but are torn apart by misunderstandings in reality. Ten years later, they reunite at work. Though Lu Xixiao harbors resentment, his love for Zhou Wan remains. As they uncover the truth behind a "factory accident," they resolve their differences and reunite.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: When his teacher confiscates his motorcycle, unruly Lu Xixiao must learn from top student Zhou Wan and rank among the 1,000 best pupils to get it back.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: As her grandmother's medical bills mount, Wan faces pressure from a petty criminal over her father's debts and offers to tutor Xixiao for extra cash.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: As they grow closer, Wan and Xixiao embark on a mission to give a group of unwanted goldfish a better home.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Guo Xiangling confronts Wan and offers to cover her grandmother's medical bills if she cuts ties with Xixiao.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Wan's grandmother collapses on the day of the college entrance exam while Xixiao gets some unwanted news about his mother's house.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Wan discovers the truth about her father's life insurance policy while Xixiao strikes a bargain to protect his mother's home.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: At the Lu family banquet, Wan seeks Xiangling's help to save her grandmother, while Xixiao clashes with his family over his dream of studying art abroad.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: After moving into the Lu family home, Wan nurses a sick Xixiao and helps him break through his creative block by organizing a children's puppet show.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Wan and Xixiao spend a carefree day at an amusement park and help Jiang Fan express his feelings for Gu Meng.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Wan struggles to raise money for her grandmother's surgery and turns to her landlord for help, while Xixiao challenges Luo He to a basketball showdown.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: After Wan suffers an injury, Xixiao finally learns the extent of her financial struggles and uncovers the truth about her grandmother's medical bills.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: After Wan races to find Xixiao before he leaves the country, the pair reunite and join forces for an unexpected rooftop rescue.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Just as Xixiao asks Wan to take their relationship to the next level, a sudden tragedy strikes, threatening their newfound happiness.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: After saying goodbye at a crowded funeral hall, Wan returns home in the throes of grief and narrowly avoids a tragic accident.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: Xixiao fulfills Wan's wish by winning her a bicycle at an arcade, deeply moving her, while Luo He, feeling betrayed, targets her in retaliation.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Family secrets erupt at Xiangling's wedding as Wan and Xixiao fight to stay together despite growing pressure to keep them apart.

episodes.name: Episode 17
episodes.overview: After pulling off a clever escape, Wan and Xixiao flee north to see the snow, but mounting financial troubles threaten their dream of a fresh start.

episodes.name: Episode 18
episodes.overview: Wan and Xixiao briefly return to Pingchuan before crafting another escape, while Xixiao's father demands his loyalty over the shareholding dispute.

episodes.name: Episode 19
episodes.overview: When Luo He kidnaps Wan, Xixiao rescues her in a violent scuffle, leaving him badly injured. In the hospital, his grandfather forces Wan to leave.

episodes.name: Episode 20
episodes.overview: At the hospital, Wan listens to Xixiao talk about his life plans and shocks him by initiating a painful conversation about their relationship.

episodes.name: Episode 21
episodes.overview: After Wan starts working for the Lanyue Group, she revisits Yangming High School and has an emotional encounter with Xixiao.

episodes.name: Episode 22
episodes.overview: Wan and Xixiao share tender moments before they face off in the Lanyue resort bidding war, where each reveals secrets that force the other to fight back.

episodes.name: Episode 23
episodes.overview: After winning the bid, Xixiao works through his feelings, while Wan uses the evidence she has against Zhongyue to join Dingshang.

episodes.name: Episode 24
episodes.overview: Forced to live together, Wan and Xixiao navigate the simmering tension between them, while Xixiao's jealousy continues to grow.

episodes.name: Episode 25
episodes.overview: While working on the Lanyue project, Wan faces harassment from the boss of a partner company, and Xixiao steps in to expose him.

episodes.name: Episode 26
episodes.overview: Jiang Fan's birthday party stirs old memories for Wan, leading her and Xixiao to admit their feelings for each other.

episodes.name: Episode 27
episodes.overview: As their romance deepens, Wan and Xixiao use business negotiations as an excuse to date, and Wan reveals some upsetting secrets about her past.

episodes.name: Episode 28
episodes.overview: Xixiao and Yan rush to the rescue after factory manager Wang abducts Wan, and new evidence exposes Zhongyue's long-hidden wrongdoings.

episodes.name: Episode 29
episodes.overview: After Wan and Xixiao cement their relationship, they reminisce about their earliest memories of each other and the 10 years they spent apart.
